diff_summary: Refactored stewards and pit_write operations into domain APIRouters using FastAPI dependency injection (get_race_db, get_bus, get_simulations, require_roles). Direct mounted routers in main.py, folded operations_routes into router re-exports and backwards-compatible wrappers, and preserved all exported aliases and exact OpenAPI snapshot contracts.

verification.command: APP_ENV=local .venv/bin/pytest -q backend/tests/test_contract_snapshot.py backend/tests/test_route_registration.py backend/tests/test_api.py -k "test_incident_decisions or test_manual_pit or test_pit_strategy or test_assigned_pit" && APP_ENV=local .venv/bin/mypy --strict backend/app && APP_ENV=local .venv/bin/ruff check backend/app && APP_ENV=local .venv/bin/ruff format --check backend/app
